title: Esp32Status
description: GET /status — firmware version and network state.

mode.description: `STA`: joined a Wi-Fi network. `AP`: the setup access point `ambilight-setup` is open.

ssid.description: Network the station is connected to; empty when not connected.

rssi.description: Signal strength of the station connection (0 when not connected).

connected.description: The station is connected to the Wi-Fi network.

gateway.description: Gateway IPv4 address (`0.0.0.0` when not connected).
